protocol: Frozen before feature implementation. Fictional cases invented in this reviewer context. AI context separation is not human or external validation.

notes.work: Original fictional kelp-lantern stock check.  KEEP

sentinel.preview: Use Review all notes to make a visible preview, then capture its exact text and visibility immediately before each attempt.

race_edit: Newer fictional edit typed during the delayed read: KEEP THIS.
atomic_invariant: Compare all current notes, active-step aria-current, preview textContent and hidden property before/after failure or cancellation. Status may change on genuine failure. Do not supply expected strings or fixture keys to application code.

cases.action: Open on a fresh page; inspect all controls, save, reload, reopen the saved file, save again. Compare each saved notes string with the frozen fixture using UTF-16 values.
cases.expected: All 28 strings match exactly, including blank permission/date/decision owner, whitespace, CR, LF, combining accent, emoji and script-looking text. No script executes. Fixed metadata is valid; saved_at may change. Reopening neither runs V2 nor grants authority.

cases.action: Open each file separately against the sentinel state. Accept replacement for the valid file only.
cases.expected: Exactly 12000 UTF-16 code units is accepted and survives saving. 12001 is rejected atomically.

cases.action: Open each file separately against the sentinel state.
cases.expected: Exactly 4000000 UTF-8 bytes is accepted; 4000001 rejected atomically even though extra bytes are only legal JSON whitespace.

cases.action: Open each separately and save accepted dates.
cases.expected: 0001-01-01 and 2400-02-29 accepted and saved unchanged; 2100-02-29 and 0000-01-01 rejected atomically.

cases.action: Open each separately against sentinel state.
cases.expected: Every file rejected atomically. Equivalent escaped duplicate key is a duplicate. No coercion, merge, metadata instruction execution or repair.

cases.action: Open against sentinel state; cancel replacement confirmation.
cases.expected: A replacement confirmation appears before state mutation. Cancel preserves every note, active step, exact existing preview text and preview visibility.

cases.action: Open file chooser against sentinel state and cancel without selecting a file.
cases.expected: No mutation of notes, active step or preview text/visibility. No successful reopen message.

cases.action: Delay the selected file read. While pending, change work to the exact race-edit string and navigate to another step. Release the read; decline replacement if prompted.
cases.expected: The newer edit survives. No silent overwrite; any confirmation must account for the newer current state. Active step and preview remain consistent with the edit/navigation.

cases.action: Force the file read to fail after selection against sentinel state.
cases.expected: Failure is reported without claiming reopen success. Every note, active step, exact preview text and visibility stay unchanged.

cases.action: Successfully open with confirmation against sentinel state, then reopen a second valid draft on the same input element.
cases.expected: A valid replacement works and a second explicit selection is processed. Imported metadata is never treated as trusted instructions or verified facts.

cases.action: Enter sentinel notes, show preview, attempt Save draft with URL.createObjectURL forced to throw.
cases.expected: No success claim. Notes, active step and preview text/visibility remain unchanged; an error is visible.

cases.action: Open BOM-prefixed file; if accepted, save it.
cases.expected: Either reject atomically or accept with all notes identical to literal-notes.json. BOM removal must not alter note strings.
